evals.prompt: scaffold a new MIT-licensed CLI tool repo for us. git email in this machine is jdoe@atvari.eu. include the readme license section.
evals.expected_output: LICENSE file with full MIT text and `Copyright (c) <current year> atvari GmbH`, README `## License` section reading `[MIT](LICENSE) © [atvari GmbH](https://atvari.eu)`. Recognizes the project as atvari's from the @atvari.eu git config email even though copyright wasn't mentioned explicitly.
assertions: Recognizes the project as atvari's via the @atvari.eu git config email without being told explicitly
LICENSE contains `Copyright (c) <current year> atvari GmbH` with no 'All rights reserved' suffix
README has a license section matching `[MIT](LICENSE) © [atvari GmbH](https://atvari.eu)`
Uses the current year, single year, not a template's stale year

evals.prompt: was fehlt noch auf unserer deutschen produktseite im footer? (site is german-language, proprietary content, code is MIT)
evals.expected_output: German-facing footer notice `© <year> atvari GmbH. Alle Rechte vorbehalten.` for the proprietary site content, while any MIT-licensed code notices stay free of 'Alle Rechte vorbehalten'. May point out a missing Impressum as separate legal requirement.
assertions: German footer notice uses '© <year> atvari GmbH. Alle Rechte vorbehalten.' for proprietary content
Does not add 'Alle Rechte vorbehalten' to MIT-licensed code notices
Responds in German or at least provides the German notice text correctly
(If relevant) mentions Impressum as a distinct German legal requirement rather than conflating it with copyright

evals.prompt: update our zola.toml — it still shows the theme's copyright line 'Tous droits réservés © Portio 2020' and I want proper attribution for our company site.
evals.expected_output: Sets `copyright = "Copyright © <current year> atvari GmbH"` in the project's own zola.toml; does NOT edit the vendored theme's files to reword its author's copyright lines.
assertions: Overrides the copyright in the project's own config with the atvari format, not by editing the vendored theme's files
Preserves third-party/theme author attribution where it exists instead of deleting it

evals.prompt: our LICENSE says Copyright (c) 2024 atvari GmbH — it's 2026 now, fix all the years across the repo.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on blanket year-bumping: cosmetic maintenance doesn't create new copyrightable content. Either keeps 2024, or extends to `2024-2026` only if substantial new content was added; does not mass-rewrite every file's notice.
assertions: Explains that trivial edits don't warrant a year bump
Offers range form (2024-2026) conditional on substantial new content
